evidence_kind: Remote compiler/test evidence; not installed, visual or full functional acceptance
changes_verified: The non-Windows driver adapter implements the shared action boundary and returns NativeUpdateBoundaryUnavailable before update/restore journaling or effects.
CI supplies canonical native fixture roots while preserving scanner link/redirect rejection.

All eleven file-backed invocation-ledger fixtures pass on both hosts; Windows also passes the native authenticated-frame-to-ledger case. This proves transaction/API fixtures, not protected storage, owner-death proof, native lease authority, installed service/effects or visual acceptance.

Registered-application inventory/exclusion source compiles on both native hosts; sixteen inventory/preference tests (including one child helper) and two producer-budget tests pass. These are fixture and compiler checks, not actual inventory/UI interaction, Active/Sleeping classification, impact measurement, native Sleep/Wake or visual acceptance.

Help source and native browser/export adapters compile on both hosts; five fake-browser and new-file export fixtures pass. No native browser/save-dialog interaction, vendor external support-tool parity or current Help pixel acceptance is established.

Native cloud UI, four provider metadata adapters, app-owned OAuth/refresh and protected vault source, reviewed trash/restore and durable recovery owners compile on both native hosts. Fixed-route fake-provider and local journal fixtures pass. This does not establish live cloud sign-in/effects, complete CCleaner parity or native pixel acceptance.
limitations: macOS validation covers Apple Silicon; Intel Mac execution is not covered.
Release compilation is not packaging, signing, installation, UI inspection or an end-to-end native feature test.
Explicit opt-in native checks remain excluded; ordinary tests include fixtures and the supported read-only checks declared in source.
